input_construction: Pinned upstream exp1 token-length construction; original RULER file when present, otherwise the author's exact fallback 'RULER fallback text. '; base and actual input hashes saved. Synthetic repeated output is a cost probe, not a task-quality evaluation.
published_selection: Successful rollout cells in out-0 (10/100 tokens, 8 devices) and out-2 through out-5 (500/1000/2000/5000 tokens, 6 devices); nominal input=10. Exclude the out-1 input-length sweep. Mean of available successful author repeats, count and range saved. Missing and failed cells are not interpolated.
target_scope: DT scores the complete supplied target plus EOS. FT retains the original exp1 default sink selection (the generated span excluding EOS), without changes to its implementation.
summary: Median of three completed warm calls, with min/max interval; only cells completing all repetitions are primary curve points.
timing: Synchronized wall time of an attribution entrypoint call; native model loading and method construction excluded, cold warmup reported separately; DT includes per-call tokenization/mapping, EOS reference creation, endpoint capture, replay, finite propagation, and returned source scores.
memory: Peak device-allocated bytes during each call, including resident model; reserved bytes recorded separately.
isolation: One fresh process per method/length cell; a crash or OOM cannot contaminate later methods.
device_policy: One explicitly selected GPU for every method. Confirm no competing GPU work before timing. No cross-device or published/current runtime pooling.
failure_policy: OOM, per-call timeout, dependency failure, and runtime error remain separate statuses; missing values are never interpolated or inferred from another method.
